acceptanceCriteria: The legacy_runtime eligibility predicate requires a real PR number, merge commit, and merged state before and after the PR.
Plan generation and recovery writing use the same eligibility predicate.
Unmerged, missing-merge-commit, and classification-mismatch inputs are rejected without writing a recovery record.
A valid normal merged-PR historical receipt remains accepted append-only.
WI-1006, WI-1007, and WI-1008 predecessor evidence remains unchanged.
goal: Prevent invalid historical classifications while preserving formal WI-1006/WI-1007/WI-1008 recovery evidence
intent: Enforce one shared legacy_runtime eligibility rule for recovery planning and recovery writes
outOfScope: adapter implementation already delivered by WI-1009
